questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: She ________ (study) for three hours before her father arrived.
questions.explanation: भूतकाल की दो घटनाओं में, एक निश्चित समय से चल रहे कार्य के लिए Past Perfect Continuous (had been studying) का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: खाली स्थान भरें: If I ________ a king, I would help the poor.
questions.explanation: काल्पनिक या असंभव इच्छाओं (Subjunctive Mood) को दर्शाने के लिए सभी Subjects के साथ 'were' का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: By next June, we ________ (finish) our matriculation exams.
questions.explanation: भविष्य में किसी निश्चित समय तक कार्य पूरा होने के लिए Future Perfect Tense (will have + V3) लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: काल की पहचान करें: 'She had already gone when I came.'
questions.explanation: वाक्य में 'had + V3' का प्रयोग हुआ है, जो Past Perfect Tense को दर्शाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: वाक्य को Past Simple में बदलें: 'He has written a beautiful poem.'
options: He had written a beautiful poem.
He was writing a beautiful poem.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect से Past Simple में बदलने के लिए केवल क्रिया का दूसरा रूप (V2 - wrote) प्रयोग करेंगे।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: The water in the pot ________ (boil) now; please turn off the gas.
questions.explanation: वर्तमान में हो रहे कार्य (now) को दर्शाने के लिए Present Continuous Tense का प्रयोग होगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: खाली स्थान भरें: I ________ (not see) him since he left Patna last month.
questions.explanation: 'Since + past event' के साथ मुख्य क्लॉज़ में Present Perfect Tense का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: We ________ (live) in this town for ten years.
questions.explanation: समय अवधि (for ten years) के साथ वर्तमान तक चल रहे कार्य के लिए Present Perfect Continuous (have been living) सही है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: समय (Tense) के प्रयोग की दृष्टि से कौन सा वाक्य सही है? | Which sentence is grammatically correct regarding Tense usage?
options: He has worked here from Monday.
He is working here since Monday.
He was working here since Monday.
He has been working here since Monday.
questions.explanation: निश्चित समय (Monday) के साथ Present Perfect Continuous में 'since' का प्रयोग व्याकरण सम्मत है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: वाक्य को Future Continuous में बदलें: 'They play football.'
questions.explanation: Future Continuous का सूत्र 'Subject + will/shall + be + V4' होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: कर्मवाच्य (Passive Voice) में बदलें: 'The cat killed the mouse.'
options: The mouse was being killed by the cat.
The mouse was killed by the cat.
The mouse is killed by the cat.
The mouse had been killed by the cat.
questions.explanation: Past Simple वाक्य का पैसिव 'was/were + V3' द्वारा बनता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: कर्तृवाच्य (Active Voice) में बदलें: 'A song is being sung by Sita.'
questions.explanation: Present Continuous के पैसिव (is being + V3) को एक्टिव में 'is/am/are + V4' में बदलते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: पैसिव वॉइस में बदलें: 'Shut the door.'
options: You are ordered to shut door.
questions.explanation: आदेशात्मक (Imperative) वाक्यों का पैसिव सामान्यतः 'Let + Subject + be + V3' से बनता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: पैसिव वॉइस में बदलें: 'Who wrote this book?'
options: Who was this book written by?
By whom was this book written?
By whom is this book written?
questions.explanation: प्रश्नवाचक 'Who' को पैसिव में 'By whom' में बदल दिया जाता है और Tense के अनुसार helping verb लगती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: पैसिव वॉइस में बदलें: 'They are building a house.'
options: A house is being built by them.
A house has been built by them.
A house was being built by them.
A house is built by them.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous का पैसिव 'is/am/are + being + V3' होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: पैसिव वॉइस में बदलें: 'He has posted the letter.'
options: The letter had been posted by him.
The letter is posted by him.
The letter has been posted by him.
The letter was posted by him.
questions.explanation: Present Perfect का पैसिव 'has/have + been + V3' होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: एक्टिव वॉइस में बदलें: 'The thief was arrested.'
options: The police is arresting the thief.
questions.explanation: जब पैसिव में 'by' के बाद एजेंट छुपा हो, तो संदर्भ के अनुसार उपयुक्त Subject (जैसे Police) लगाते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: पैसिव वॉइस में बदलें: 'I know him.'
questions.explanation: 'Know' क्रिया के पैसिव में 'by' के स्थान पर हमेशा 'to' preposition का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: पैसिव वॉइस में बदलें: 'One must do one's duty.'
options: One's duty must be done by one.
questions.explanation: सामान्य नैतिक वाक्यों में 'one's' और 'by one' का प्रयोग पैसिव में हटा दिया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: पैसिव वॉइस में बदलें: 'They saw him climb the wall.'
options: He was saw climbing the wall.
He was seen climbing the wall by them.
He had seen climbing the wall.
He was seen to climb the wall.
questions.explanation: Bare infinitive (climb) पैसिव वॉइस में 'to + V1' (to climb) में बदल जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: अप्रत्यक्ष कथन (Indirect Speech) में बदलें: Ram said, 'I am reading a book.'
options: Ram said that he is reading a book.
Ram said that I was reading a book.
Ram said that he was reading a book.
Ram told that he read a book.
questions.explanation: Reporting Verb (said) भूतकाल में है, इसलिए Present Continuous को Past Continuous में बदलेंगे और Pronoun 'I' को 'he' में।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में बदलें: He said to me, 'Where are you going?'
options: He asked me where was I going.
He asked me where I was going.
He told me where I was going.
He asked to me where I went.
questions.explanation: प्रश्नवाचक वाक्यों में 'said to' को 'asked' में बदलते हैं, और प्रश्नवाचक संरचना साधारण वाक्य (I was going) में बदलती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में बदलें: The teacher said, 'The sun rises in the east.'
options: The teacher said the sun rising in the east.
The teacher told that the sun rises in the east.
The teacher said that the sun rose in the east.
The teacher said that the sun rises in the east.
questions.explanation: सार्वभौमिक सत्य (Universal Truth) का Tense इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में कभी नहीं बदलता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में बदलें: She says, 'I am very busy.'
options: She says that she is very busy.
She says that I am very busy.
She says that she was very busy.
She said that she is very busy.
questions.explanation: यदि Reporting Verb वर्तमान काल (says) में हो, तो Reported Speech का Tense नहीं बदलता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में बदलें: He said to her, 'Please give me your pen.'
options: He ordered her to give him her pen.
He told her to please give him her pen.
He requested her to give him her pen.
He requested her that give him her pen.
questions.explanation: प्रार्थना वाले वाक्यों (Imperative with 'Please') में 'said to' को 'requested' में बदलकर 'to + V1' का प्रयोग करते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में बदलें: He said, 'Alas! I have lost my purse.'
options: He said with sorrow that he lost his purse.
He exclaimed with sorrow that he had lost his purse.
He exclaimed that he lost his purse.
He told with grief he has lost his purse.
questions.explanation: विस्मयादिबोधक (Exclamatory) वाक्यों में 'Alas!' को 'exclaimed with sorrow' में बदला जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में बदलें: She said to Ram, 'Do not play in the sun.'
options: She forbade Ram to play in the sun.
She said to Ram not to play in the sun.
She requested Ram to not play in the sun.
She ordered Ram that do not play in the sun.
questions.explanation: 'Do not' वाले आदेशों को 'forbade + to + V1' या 'ordered + not to + V1' में बदला जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में बदलें: He said, 'May God bless you!'
options: He prayed that God should bless you.
He prayed that God might bless me.
He said that God might bless me.
He wished that God may bless you.
questions.explanation: इच्छासूचक (Optative) वाक्यों में 'said' को 'prayed/wished' में और 'May' को 'might' में बदलते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में बदलें: He said, 'I wrote a letter yesterday.'
options: He said that he wrote a letter yesterday.
He said that he had written a letter yesterday.
He said that he wrote a letter the previous day.
He said that he had written a letter the previous day.
questions.explanation: Past Simple को Past Perfect (had written) में और 'yesterday' को 'the previous day' में बदलते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में बदलें: He said, 'Let us go to the market.'
options: He said to go to the market.
He suggested that they should go to the market.
He proposed that we must go to market.
He ordered them to go to the market.
questions.explanation: 'Let us' वाले वाक्यों को इनडायरेक्ट में 'suggested/proposed + that + they/we + should + V1' में बदलते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: Neither Ram nor his brothers ________ present.
questions.explanation: जब दो Subject 'neither... nor' से जुड़े हों, तो क्रिया पास वाले Subject (his brothers - Plural) के अनुसार लगती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: The captain, along with his crew members, ________ lost.
questions.explanation: जब वाक्य में 'along with' हो, तो क्रिया प्रथम Subject (The captain - Singular) के अनुसार लगती है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: Bread and butter ________ my favorite breakfast.
questions.explanation: जब दो शब्द मिलकर एक एकल विचार (single idea/food) को दर्शाते हैं, तो Singular Verb (is) का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: Mathematics ________ an interesting subject.
questions.explanation: विषयों के नाम (Mathematics, Physics) रूप में Plural दिखते हैं, पर वास्तव में Singular होते हैं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: A number of students ________ failed.
questions.explanation: 'A number of' के साथ हमेशा Plural Verb (have/are) का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: The number of boys in the class ________ fifty.
questions.explanation: 'The number of' एक निश्चित संख्या को दर्शाता है, अतः इसके साथ Singular Verb (is/was) का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: Each of the candidates ________ interviewed yesterday.
questions.explanation: 'Each of / One of' के बाद Plural Noun आता है, लेकिन Verb हमेशा Singular (was) होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: Slow and steady ________ the race.
questions.explanation: यह एक प्रसिद्ध कहावत है जो एक ही विचार को व्यक्त करती है, अतः Singular Verb (wins) का प्रयोग होगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: Ten miles ________ a long distance to walk.
questions.explanation: निश्चित दूरी, समय या रकम जब एक इकाई के रूप में प्रस्तुत हो, तो Singular Verb (is) लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सब्जेक्ट-वर्ब एग्रीमेंट (Syntax) के नियम से कौन सा वाक्य सही है? | Which sentence is grammatically correct regarding Subject-Verb Agreement?
options: Many a man have made this mistake.
Many a men has made this mistake.
Many men has made this mistake.
Many a man has made this mistake.
questions.explanation: 'Many a' के बाद हमेशा Singular Noun (man) और Singular Verb (has) का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: अशुद्ध वाक्य को शुद्ध करें: 'He has left the city two days ago.'
options: He left the city two days ago.
He has been leaving the city two days ago.
He was leaving the city two days ago.
He had left the city two days ago.
questions.explanation: जब वाक्य में 'ago' जैसे भूतकाल के सूचक शब्द हों, तो Present Perfect नहीं बल्कि Past Simple Tense (V2) का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: पैसिव में बदलें: 'Who is calling you?'
options: By whom is you being called?
By whom are you being called?
By whom you are being called?
questions.explanation: Present Continuous के प्रश्नवाचक पैसिव में 'By whom + are (according to 'you') + Subject + being + V3' लगता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: इनडायरेक्ट में बदलें: He said, 'Thank you.'
options: He said thank you to me.
questions.explanation: 'He said, Thank you' का सीधा इनडायरेक्ट रूप 'He thanked me' होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: The news ________ not as bad as we expected.
questions.explanation: 'News' एक अनकाउंटेबल नाउन है जिसे व्याकरण में Singular माना जाता है, इसलिए 'is' लगेगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: अशुद्ध वाक्य को शुद्ध करें: 'I prefer tea than coffee.'
options: I prefer tea more than coffee.
questions.explanation: 'Prefer' और 'Preferable' के साथ तुलना करने के लिए 'than' के स्थान पर हमेशा 'to' का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: She behaves as if she ________ everything.
questions.explanation: 'As if' या 'As though' के बाद आने वाले क्लॉज़ में काल्पनिक स्थिति के लिए Past tense (knew/were) का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: पैसिव में बदलें: 'Open your book.'
options: You are asked to open book.
questions.explanation: आदेशात्मक वाक्यों का पैसिव 'Let + Subject + be + V3' के नियम से बनाया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: इनडायरेक्ट में बदलें: Father said, 'Honesty is the best policy.'
options: Father told that honesty is best policy.
Father said that honesty is the best policy.
Father said that honesty was the best policy.
Father exclaimed that honesty is best policy.
questions.explanation: कहावतें और नैतिक सत्य (Proverbs) का काल इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में नहीं बदला जाता।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: Either my sister or my parents ________ coming.
questions.explanation: 'Either... or' नियम में क्रिया अपने सबसे पास वाले कर्ता (my parents - Plural) के अनुसार 'are' होगी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही काल रूप चुनें: I ________ (not write) the letter yet.
questions.explanation: वाक्य में 'yet' (अभी तक) का प्रयोग हुआ है, जिसके साथ सामान्यतः Present Perfect Negative का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'The scenery (A) / of Kashmir (B) / are very beautiful (C) / No error (D)'
questions.explanation: 'Scenery' एक अनकाउंटेबल नाउन है, जिसका प्लूरल नहीं होता और इसके साथ Singular Verb (is) का प्रयोग होना चाहिए।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'He is (A) / one of those men (B) / who does not lie (C) / No error (D)'
questions.explanation: जब 'who' Relative Pronoun के रूप में आए, तो क्रिया उसके पहले वाले Noun (men - Plural) के अनुसार 'do not' होनी चाहिए।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'I asked him (A) / why was he crying (B) / in the room (C) / No error (D)'
questions.explanation: इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में प्रश्नवाचक संरचना नहीं होती; 'why was he' के स्थान पर 'why he was' का प्रयोग होगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'I have (A) / seen him (B) / three days ago (C) / No error (D)'
questions.explanation: 'ago' (भूतकाल) होने के कारण यहाँ Present Perfect 'I have seen' के स्थान पर Past Simple 'I saw' होना चाहिए।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'Neither the teacher (A) / nor the students (B) / was happy (C) / No error (D)'
questions.explanation: 'Neither... nor' में क्रिया पास वाले कर्ता (the students - Plural) के अनुसार 'were' होनी चाहिए।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'If he will study (A) / hard, he will (B) / pass the examination (C) / No error (D)'
questions.explanation: शर्त सूचक वाक्य (Conditional clause) में 'will' का प्रयोग नहीं होता; 'If he studies' होना चाहिए।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'He is senior (A) / than me (B) / in service (C) / No error (D)'
questions.explanation: 'Senior', 'Junior', 'Prior' आदि लैटिन कॉम्परेटिव शब्दों के साथ 'than' के स्थान पर 'to' का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'The rich (A) / is generally (B) / not helpful (C) / No error (D)'
questions.explanation: 'The rich' पूरी अमीर जाति (Plural) को दर्शाता है, अतः इसके साथ Verb 'are' का प्रयोग होना चाहिए।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'She died (A) / from cancer (B) / last month (C) / No error (D)'
questions.explanation: किसी बीमारी से मृत्यु होने के अर्थ में 'die of' का प्रयोग होता है, 'die from' का नहीं।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'Unless you do not (A) / work hard, you (B) / cannot succeed (C) / No error (D)'
questions.explanation: 'Unless' स्वयं एक नकारात्मक शब्द है, इसके साथ दोबारा 'do not' का प्रयोग वर्जित है। 'Unless you work hard' सही है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में बदलें: He said to me, 'Are you ill?'
options: He asked me was I ill.
He asked me that if I was ill.
He told me that I was ill.
He asked me if I was ill.
questions.explanation: सहायक क्रिया से शुरू होने वाले प्रश्नों में Inverted Commas के स्थान पर 'if/whether' का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: पैसिव वॉइस में बदलें: 'The boy is flying a kite.'
options: A kite is being flown by the boy.
A kite was being flown by the boy.
A kite is flown by the boy.
A kite has been flown by the boy.
questions.explanation: Present Continuous (is flying) का पैसिव 'is being flown' होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: Time and tide ________ for no man.
questions.explanation: यह एक अत्यंत लोकप्रिय लोकोक्ति है, जिसमें 'wait' (Plural Verb) को मानक अंग्रेजी में सही माना जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही काल रूप चुनें: I ________ (buy) this phone yesterday.
questions.explanation: वाक्य में 'yesterday' भूतकाल का सूचक है, अतः Past Simple (V2 - bought) का प्रयोग होगा।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: अशुद्ध वाक्य को शुद्ध करें: 'One of my friends are a teacher.'
options: One of my friends is a teacher.
One of my friends were a teacher.
One of my friend is a teacher.
questions.explanation: 'One of' के साथ Plural Noun आता है पर मूल कर्ता 'One' (Singular) होने के कारण क्रिया 'is' लगेगी।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में बदलें: The teacher said, 'Two and two make four.'
options: The teacher said two and two makes four.
The teacher said that two and two made four.
The teacher told that two and two make four.
The teacher said that two and two make four.
questions.explanation: गणितीय तथ्य (Mathematical facts) का काल इनडायरेक्ट स्पीच में अपरिवर्तित रहता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: पैसिव वॉइस में बदलें: 'People speak English all over the world.'
options: English was spoken all over the world.
English has spoken all over the world.
English is spoken all over the world.
English is being spoken all over the world.
questions.explanation: सामान्य तथ्यों के पैसिव में 'by people' लिखना अनावश्यक माना जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: Neither of the two answers ________ correct.
questions.explanation: 'Neither of' का प्रयोग दो में से किसी एक के लिए होता है, अतः इसके साथ Singular Verb (is) का प्रयोग होता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: त्रुटि पहचानें: 'He has been (A) / ill since (B) / ten days (C) / No error (D)'
questions.explanation: समय की अवधि (ten days - Period of time) के पहले 'since' नहीं, बल्कि 'for' का प्रयोग किया जाता है।
questions.subject: English

questions.q: सही क्रिया रूप चुनें: We ________ (watch) television when the light went out.
questions.explanation: जब भूतकाल में एक कार्य जारी था (were watching) और दूसरा कार्य हुआ (went out), तो पहले कार्य के लिए Past Continuous लगता है।
questions.subject: English
